definitions.text: An exclamation expressive of disgust, horror, or recoil. Its utterance is usually accompanied by a shudder.
To disfigure; to make ugly. [R.] Mad. D'Arblay.
In an ugly manner; with deformity.
The quality or state of being ugly.

Offensive to the sight; contrary to beauty; being of disagreeable or loathsome aspect; unsightly; repulsive; deformed. The ugly view of his deformed crimes. Spenser. Like the toad, ugly and venomous. Shak. O, I have passed a miserable night, So full of ugly sights, of ghastly dreams. Shak.
Ill-natured; crossgrained; quarrelsome; as, an ugly temper; to feel ugly. [Colloq. U. S.]
Unpleasant; disagreeable; likely to cause trouble or loss; as, an ugly rumor; an ugly customer. [Colloq.]
A shade for the face, projecting from the bonnet. [Colloq. Eng.] C. Kingsley.
A Mongolian race, ancestors of the Finns. [Written also Uigrian.]
Ugly; offensive; loathsome. [Obs.] -- Ug"some*ness, n. [Obs.] "The horror and ugsomeness of death." Latimer.
